Day 3 Convective Outlook  
NWS Storm Prediction Center Norman OK
0214 AM CST Thu Nov 05 2026

Valid 071200Z - 081200Z

...NO THUNDERSTORM AREAS FORECAST...

...SUMMARY...
Thunderstorms are unlikely on Saturday.

...Synopsis...
An upper low will move across the northeastern states on Saturday
with another shortwave aloft diving southeastward across the upper
MS Valley. This will support cool conditions as high pressure
settles into the MS/OH Valleys, with offshore winds across the Gulf
and Atlantic coasts. High pressure will also exist across the Great
Basin, behind an upper low dropping southeastward into Mexico. As
such, little if any instability will be present to support
thunderstorms over land.

..Jewell.. 11/05/2026
